title: Loser Modpack
description: A lightweight, performance-focused, vanilla+ modpack for my friends to play on our SMP.
body:
A modpack for my SMP.

## Purpose

A vanilla+ modpack for me to play with my friends on an SMP we have.

## Features:

- performance mods
- quality of life mods
- visuals enhancement mods
- audio mods
- hud enhancement mods
- a few gameplay mods
- a few texture packs improving the visuals and hud

## Mod List:

- Ambient sounds
- AppleSkin
- Better third person
- Blur+
- Bridging mod
- Chat animation
- Chat heads
- Cherished worlds
- Continuity
- Cool rain
- Cubes without borders
- Distant horizons
- Falling tree
- Farmer's delight refabricated

## Support mod list:

- Entity model features
- Entity texture features
- Cloth config API
- Creative core
- Fabric api
- Fabric language kotlin

## Resource pack list:

- Fancy crops
- Better lanterns
- Carrot hunger bar
- Compact font
- Door tweaks
- Dramatic skies
- Enchant icons
- Enchanted books: re-covered
- Enchantment glows
- Fast better grass
- Fresh animations
- Fresh animations: extensions
- 3d ladders
- 3d rails
- Recolorful containers dark

I'm sure i'm missing some, idk go see yourself
